style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: derived from the floor tile, the picture every counted square wears: keys in its sand-beige family and a berry Enter as the treat, the same keypad as the chapter's other tile-grid tools; never red or violet

images.why: Phase 1 screen 'a traced leaf' and Opening 'a traced leaf lies on squared paper': the leaf lying inside the traced outline, clipped to the outline in code
images.prompt: A single dried banyan leaf lying flat with its short stalk pointing left, a broad smooth oval that is wider than it is tall: golden-yellow turning brown towards the rim, with pale fine veins, a matte slightly papery surface and a gently uneven real edge.

images.why: Phase 4 screen 'a traced hand with its squares all marked': the hand lying inside the traced outline, clipped to the outline in code
images.prompt: A child's open right hand held flat, palm down, with the fingers together and the thumb stretched out a little: warm wheat-brown natural skin with fine real skin texture and short clean nails, seen from above and ending at the wrist.

images.why: Description 'Number the whole squares inside a traced shape, mark each part square': each counted square (whole, more than half, half) is one floor tile, tinted in code; a square less than half inside stays warm white; at most 40 a screen
images.prompt: One square warm sand-beige ceramic floor tile with a softly bevelled edge and a smooth glazed surface.
